name: Product Editor for WooCommerce
author: speitzako

sections.description:
Product Editor is the lightweight, fast, and completely free solution for bulk editing WooCommerce products.
Now fully compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

Maintainer Note: This plugin has been adopted by a new maintainer (Jan 2026). Expect regular updates, security fixes, and performance improvements.

Features

  • ⚡️ HPOS Compatible (New in 1.1.0)
  • Increase / decrease prices by value or percentage
  • Bulk edit Sale Prices & Dates
  • Filter by Category, Tag, or SKU
  • Undo changes (History support)
  • Round prices automatically
  • Works with Simple, Variable, and External products

Need Help?
Contact support directly at: speitzako@gmail.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload product-editor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Products > Product Editor.
sections.faq:
Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes! Since version 1.1.0, the plugin declares full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

How do I undo a change?

The plugin stores a history of your bulk edits. Simply click the “Undo” button in the history log to revert prices.
